Glasgow Gaelic Club

Probably composed by the piper William Gunn (c1788-1867) who was for a while piper to the Glasgow Gaelic Club. It was published in his ‘Caledonian Repository of Music Adapted for the Bagpipes’ (1848).

↳ Posted by Nigel Gatherer on October 18th, 2011.

The Gaelic Club, X:4

This setting appears in O’Neill’s Waifs and Strays of Gaelic Melody, 1922, no. 143.

↳ Posted by Moxhe on November 13th, 2015.

Some people play it in a bit more pointed way, as I’ve done here. I think this approach gives it a bit more of a swing !
